item.title: Pakistani man gets 27 years in US jail for Iran-backed plot to kill Trump
item.description: A Pakistani man, Asif Merchant, was sentenced to 330 months in prison in the US for plotting to assassinate President Donald Trump and other prominent politicians at Iran's behest in 2024. Prosecutors said the plot was planned in retaliation for the 2020 killing of Iranian commander Qassem Soleimani. Merchant was convicted in March, while the plot was foiled before any attack took place.
item.dc:creator: Abhishek Mishra

item.title: Jennifer Lopez unveils renovated $17.5m California estate after her divorce
item.description: Jennifer Lopez has recently transformed her Hidden Hills estate into a stylish sanctuary after her high-profile divorce. The property features carefully curated interiors, including a newly designed living room and renovated outdoor spaces. She hosted family and friends at her estate for a Memorial Day gathering, showcasing her new lifestyle. With five en-suite bedrooms and a guesthouse, the residence accommodates visitors comfortably.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Michigan woman loses appeal for larger share of marital wealth after 2018 $705,000 deal
item.description: In a recent court case, Cassandra Fameux from Michigan aimed to obtain a greater portion of her divorce settlement. She argued that a property agreement worth $705,000, signed during her guardianship, was unjust. However, the appeals court affirmed the earlier ruling, confirming the agreement's binding nature. The court dismissed her claims of undue pressure, leaving her with far less than the nearly $1 million she anticipated.

item.title: Texas court blocks DNA test in dispute over handwritten will leaving estate to two beneficiaries
item.description: In Texas, a man’s handwritten will sparked controversy after naming two beneficiaries, which his cousin contested. This initiated a legal battle over the will's authenticity. The probate court called for DNA testing to verify the cousin's relationship but was overruled by a Texas appeals court, deeming the judge had overstepped. The legitimacy of the will remains under scrutiny as the probate court continues its review.

item.title: Indiana farmer not liable after crop-spraying drone struck Lonnie Howard in 2024
item.description: An incident involving an agricultural drone on a farm in Indiana led to a significant legal dispute. Lonnie Howard claimed injuries when the drone collided with his arm during a spraying operation. However, farmer Mark D Rose was deemed not liable, as he lacked control over the spraying process and did not supervise his son.

item.title: Indiana court upholds extra approval for 32-home Crooked Lake project with shared access
item.description: A proposed residential project near Crooked Lake has faced significant legal hurdles over access rights to the waterfront for numerous homes. Local residents expressed concerns regarding potential overuse of a single dock for entry. The Steuben County Plan Commission mandated that a special exception be obtained, a ruling the developer challenged. However, the Indiana Court of Appeals upheld the commission's directive, reinforcing the need to adhere to zoning laws.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Bird flu wiped out the Sandwich tern colony in 2022, three years later, 756 of them have returned
item.description: After suffering from High Pathogenic Avian Influenza in 2022, the Sandwich tern colony at Pagham Harbour faced severe population loss. Through extensive conservation efforts, the colony saw a remarkable recovery, breeding 756 pairs by 2026. This comeback has also benefited other bird species, such as black-headed gulls and avocets. RSPB rangers and volunteers have played a crucial role in habitat management and safety.

item.title: Alabama man wins $126,504 judgment over stormwater damage, but faces setback in latest appeal
item.description: William D. Carpenter triumphed in court, securing a judgment of $126,504.64 for stormwater damage in Alabama. However, challenges arose when he tried to enforce this judgment, prompting him to initiate a new lawsuit against both the homeowners' association and the homeowners. The Alabama Supreme Court dismissed his appeal over procedural technicalities, leaving the original claims of negligence and trespass unresolved as the case continues to unfold in the lower court.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: November’s sky has a full supermoon, the Leonid meteor shower, and Taurid showers, NASA says
item.description: November brings a captivating array of astronomical phenomena set to enchant stargazers everywhere. Mark your calendars for the Leonids meteor shower peaking on November 17 and 18 for a chance to catch stunning shooting stars. Don't miss the Taurids meteor showers illuminating the skies with bright fireballs around November 5 and 12. Additionally, on November 24, a spectacular supermoon will grace our night sky, appearing exceptionally large and luminous.

item.title: UConn sued over bank naming deal at arena built with donor's $1 million gift
item.description: The daughters of Harry A. Gampel have filed a lawsuit against the University of Connecticut regarding naming rights for a building that they contend should bear their father's name, as per a 1989 agreement. This legal action comes after M&T Bank's recent renaming of the arena, prompting concerns about the erosion of their father's legacy.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Bristol Wetland Plan: Bristol funds 200 projects; wetlands aim to curb flooding
item.description: Bristol is embarking on an innovative wetland restoration initiative, designed to enrich urban environments and promote biodiversity. This ambitious program aims to establish over 200 projects that enhance flood protection and improve accessibility for city dwellers. Notably, the introduction of floating gardens in September 2026 reflects the project's early achievements in rehabilitating urban habitats.

item.title: Dua Lipa’s £6.75m London home still under renovation, with 2027 finish date
item.description: Dua Lipa has been deeply involved in the extensive renovation of her north London Victorian home, which she bought back in 2020. The project has hit snags due to planning disputes and environmental issues tied to the conservation area. Currently, intensive excavation is underway with hopes for several leisure and artistic areas. Unfortunately, the anticipated completion has now been delayed until July 2027, leaving the site buzzing with construction activity.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Bela Lugosi's 'daytime coffin' Hollywood mansion sells for $6.75 million
item.description: Villa Dorada, a stunning Spanish Revival estate, hit the market for $7.5 million after half a century, captivating potential buyers with its storied past that includes Hollywood legends like Bela Lugosi and Jimmy Van Heusen. The property is rich in architectural details, featuring classic magnesite floors and intricately hand-carved doors. Nestled in the exclusive Outpost Estates neighborhood, the villa ultimately closed at $6.75 million
item.dc:creator: TOI Lifestyle Desk

item.title: Four motorcyclists crashed in Kentucky waste spill; court upholds $11m award
item.description: In an unusual incident on May 31, 2022, a truck carrying human waste spilled its load onto Interstate 24, leading to a dangerous motorcycle accident. High-speed riders lost control, resulting in severe injuries and lasting emotional trauma. After a trial in May 2025, a jury determined that the injured parties deserved $11 million in compensation.
